pr_body:
Implement `sigprocmask()` by simply redirecting call to the `pthread_sigmask()` as they are identical in single threaded application.

Fixes #66928

issue_context.title: posix: implement `sigprocmask()`
issue_context.body:
This is part of the See [POSIX Roadmap for LTSv3](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51211) (RFC #51211).

`sigprocmask()` is required as part of `POSIX_SIGNALS` [Subprofiling Option Group](https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/xrat/V4_subprofiles.html).

For more information, please refer to https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/sigprocmask.html
